correctness.rationale: For monotone absolute coefficients a_n=|eta_n|, decompose R into dyadic diagonal triangular blocks D_j L_{2^j} plus earlier-column rank-one rectangles. The difference-matrix Gram inverse of L_N has explicit sine eigenvalues and singular values s_k=[2 sin((2k−1)pi/(4N+2))]^{-1}, so ||L_N||_1 is comparable uniformly to N log(N+1). The ideal inequality bounds diagonal block trace norms by a_{2^j}2^j(j+1); each earlier rectangular block is rank one of trace norm <=2^j a_{2^j}. Summability gives trace-class norm upper and entrywise correct extension. Conversely orthogonal dyadic trace-norm pinching gives sum ||D_j L_{2^j}||_1 <= ||R||_1; monotonicity bounds each below by a_{2^{j+1}} c 2^j(j+1), yielding matching dyadic lower after index shift. Weighted condensation then gives c sum a_n log(n+2)<=||R||_1<=C sum a_n log(n+2) and for a_n~[n(log n)^r]^{-1} iff r>2. Finite difference-matrix Gram/eigenvector and sample N=1,2,4,8,16,64 singular-value sums independently checked; infinite result relies on analytic pinching/decomposition, not finite tests.
